name: car-rental
title: Rental cars
description: Finds the best-value rental car for a trip when you ask: checks the comparison sites first, then the rental companies directly, compares all-in totals for the car class and companies you prefer, and recommends one with its link. Never books.

task.description: Run with `jori tasks run car-rental --task "<where; pickup; return>"` (the request needs its place and dates). On request: find the best-value rental car for a given place and pickup/return time (or the stay on the travel timeline the request points to). Reads the user's rental-car preferences from memory, searches the comparison sites first and then the rental companies' own sites, compares all-in totals for the preferred classes at mainstream companies, and replies with one recommendation, the runners-up and the link. Never reserves.
